mechanism: Canonical-NLL output-head coordinate search evaluated against a document-disjoint training guard. The selected coordinate improved proposal NLL but worsened the guard, so the move was atomically rejected.
summary: A prospectively frozen canonical-NLL output-head search selected a coordinate that improved exact proposal NLL but worsened a document-disjoint training guard. The move was atomically rejected, exact rerun replay passed, the source model was retained, and public test plus all later gates stayed closed.
